title: Section Header
description: A header bar with actions for a page, a section or a card, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: a page header carries a breadcrumb trail, a display heading and a status line, a section header sits on a rule and a card header tops a card that holds the body passed to it, each with a secondary and a primary action and its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the full trail and the actions beside the heading at @sm, a larger heading at @md, the largest heading and a larger description at @lg.
